title: SmimeError does not implement Serialize+Deserialize unlike other public result types
description: smime-tree/src/error.rs: CertChainError, VerificationResult, and SignerResult all implement Serialize+Deserialize (required by the workspace invariant 'Both crates: owned, lifetime-free public types'). SmimeError does not. A caller that stores a VerificationResult or SignerResult will find that SmimeError (which appears in SmimeError::AllSignersFailed and inside SignerResult) cannot be round-tripped through storage. This is an API contract gap: the workspace CLAUDE.md says 'All public structs implement Serialize+Deserialize', and SmimeError is a public type. Adding derives requires that UnsupportedAlgorithm carry a String instead of a &'static str for the inner message, which is the only non-trivially-serializable field.
close_reason: Duplicate of MIME-8zt.70 — SmimeError now has Serialize/Deserialize.
